visual_primary_facts.title: Unexpected Interruption
visual_primary_facts.whole_printed_game_text: If a battle was just initiated, target an opponent's female non-droid character present with Xizor. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > target's ability, target excluded from battle and adds her power to Xizor's for remainder of turn.
